qualification.producer: MVC's singleton DefaultModelMetadataProvider lazily runs the default binding-details provider per cached metadata identity; record constructor discovery reads real reflected constructor parameters and PropertyHelper's visible properties.
qualification.consumer: ComplexObjectModelBinderProvider reads BoundConstructor and builds parameter binders; DefaultModelMetadataProvider constructs the invoker used by ComplexObjectModelBinder.
qualification.workload: The existing ComplexRecordIntegrationTest source contains 52 record declarations: 18 with one parameter, 31 with two, two with three, and one with four. This is native fixture evidence, not customer telemetry.
qualification.rationale: The nested existence scan is real, but the reviewed workload is small and metadata results are reused. No evidence establishes material benefit from adding a temporary hash structure or another cache. A delegate-removal rewrite would not address the scan's complexity and is not retained without a demonstrated material workload.
qualification.limitations: Not strictly once per Type: distinct metadata identities/providers, invalidation and concurrent first use can repeat discovery. No application frequency, elapsed-time, allocation, or throughput conclusion is claimed.

correctness.result: The final native attempt built the same-role MVC Core product assembly, then failed on four missing Blazor JS assets before test discovery. Constructor, cache and hidden-property assertions remain unexecuted.
correctness.redGreen: Not applicable: no fix or optimization implemented.

hotReload: Existing MVC metadata and PropertyHelper cache invalidation traced. No cache or derived-state change; no live-edit validation or new handler.

coordinatorOnly.remainingAdmission: Only reconsider a candidate after evidence of a material real record-metadata workload. Any future comparison, same-host/runtime pairing, finalization and publication remain coordinator-only.
